We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces an SN2 reaction: C-N formed and C-Cl broken, breaking a halide functional group. The target molecule is given: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "halide"? functional_groups_formed includes "C-N"? Also bonds broken: C-Cl. Let's search.
